related.description: 😇A pyTorch implementation of the DeepMoji model: state-of-the-art deep learning model for analyzing sentiment, emotion, sarcasm etc
Deep-learning  by using Pytorch.  Basic nns like Logistic, CNN, RNN, LSTM and some examples are implemented by complex model.
High-level library to help with training and evaluating neural networks in PyTorch flexibly and transparently.
